summary: Adoption review 2026-10-21. An independent review compared the pre-change backup line by line; dropped clauses were restored, then duplicates of constraints.md and the template were pruned (instructions 593 -> 795 words, growth from the generic template workflow). No packs to prune; ADRs current (agent-workflow amended). harness-adoption marked maintained. Evidence: node --test 157/157 in an isolated copy with minimal env; check-evidence valid; audit 0 critical, 0 warnings. Follow-up the same day: closed the spec gaps with 21 new tests (verify script, briefing format label in text and browser dashboard, claude-primary settlement/limits/status, lab follow-ups), moved job settlement verbatim into src/job-settle.js, and fixed /status (handleMessage did not forward readCodexLimits, causing ReferenceError; takes effect after the next service restart). An existing router test ran the live trading CLI (/tr 보유) from every test run, including earlier 'isolated' runs today; it now uses a fake CLI in a temp dir, and the live ledger and token files show no modification. verification, claude-primary and lab-followup are now maintained. Evidence: node --test 178/178 in an isolated copy.
